name: Walnut Oil
siboNotes: Pure walnut oil is FODMAP-free and well-tolerated on SIBO diets. Choose cold-pressed varieties to avoid additives that might trigger symptoms.
preparationTips: Store in refrigerator after opening to prevent rancidity
Use for finishing dishes rather than high-heat cooking
Check labels to ensure no garlic or onion additives
Start with small amounts as high-fat foods can trigger symptoms in some people
